notes: Upstream-clone bugfix in pylint-dev/pylint (v4.2 family): false-positive protected-access (W0212) when a protected member is read through self.__class__ inside an instance method; the same read via type(self) is already accepted. Build/reproduce/patch/verify chain against the real tree, all offline and pure-Python (no compile time). The agent must find the emitting check (visit_attribute path in the classes checker), understand that self.__class__ is the class of the method's first parameter, and add a guard so only accesses through another object's class still warn. Verifier: provenance (only pylint/checkers/classes/class_checker.py may differ byte-wise), CLI repro asserting the exact remaining W0212 line set, golden functional test access_to_protected_members (extracted from fix commit at build time) planted and run via the project's own pytest harness, the project's own access/ functional-test family, and three authored hidden cases (renamed first parameter, inherited member through the MRO, mixed type(self)/self.__class__ spellings) with byte-exact expected message-line sets. Oracle applies an authored one-hunk patch mirroring the upstream fix.
